The first condition forces D=r0-d>b U_y>0; the second yields bh>1+a>a. Exact identity bU_y-D=bhm+(bh-a)D/a+b(h+1)epsilon has all strictly positive terms, contradicting bU_y<D. Independent SymPy identity expansion verified. This is an impossible pair of sufficient hypotheses, NOT a claim the positive equilibrium is never globally attracting or a corrected theorem.
